_note: RATES nightly pull (run_secondary.py --rates) - SOFR and Treasury options, CAPTURE ONLY, never ingested (js/oi.js has no rates product spec). Written to out/<date>/quikstrike_rates/ and folded into analysis/output/iv_term/iv_term_daily.csv by iv_term_archive.py. Purpose: our own daily rates implied-vol term structure (the CVOL TUVY/TYVY/SRVL lens of C.OG's Cross-Asset Volatility lesson), since CVOL history is licensed and cmegroup.com blocks scripts. pid/pf are filled by `python run_secondary.py --rates --learn "SR3"` (pick the product in QuikStrike's picker, close Chrome). `match` is text the tool header must contain or the pull refuses - a guess until the first real capture confirms the heading.

SR3._what: 3-Month SOFR quarterly options (SR3). Price = 100 - rate; check whether QuikStrike's VOLATILITY column is price vol or bp vol on the first capture.

ZT._what: 2-Year T-Note options (TU): the listed proxy for the 2-year yield CVOL (TUVY) the lesson leads with.

TN._what: 10-Year Ultra T-Note options (OTN): the exact product in the Cross-Asset Volatility lesson.
